applyTo: "**/*.html,**/*.css,**/*.scss,**/*.js,**/*.jsx,**/*.ts,**/*.tsx,**/*.vue,**/*.svelte"

# Browser-facing Modern Web Guidance

For browser-facing HTML, CSS, UI, client-side JavaScript/TypeScript tasks, consult `.github/skills/web-guidance/SKILL.md` when applicable. A file extension alone is not sufficient: exclude server routes, backend TypeScript, node scripts, CI, build config and non-browser tests. Respect approved requirements, browser support, existing third-party skills, privacy and tool permissions. Guidance unavailable is a non-blocking optional setup limitation.

Builders can invoke `/ux-review` for a read-only experience review; it does not authorize fixes or become a release gate.
